r13_contract.comparisonModel: IF construction_stage_date >= '2003-09-01' AND iceClass IN {'IA Super','IA','IB','IC'}, THEN compute P_min = K_e*(R_CH/1000)^(3/2)/D_p at UIWL and LIWL; use draught-dependent inputs at the corresponding draught, use L and B at UIWL for both calculations, and require mcrPower_kW >= max(P_min_UIWL_kW, P_min_LIWL_kW). K_e shall be selected from Table 3-1. Table 3-1 values for conventional propulsion systems: 1 propeller: CP propeller or electric or hydraulic propulsion machinery 2.03, FP propeller 2.26; 2 propellers: 1.44 and 1.60; 3 propellers: 1.18 and 1.31.
